title: Northgate Credit Cards Reward Pooling and the Membership Annual Reward
content:
Member services training note: questions answered on where the rewards of a Northgate Credit Cards account collect, how the gas and EV charging cap is counted, and how card rewards stand beside the membership's Annual Reward.

## Statement of principle

All purchases on one Northgate card account, including those of authorized users where the card's authorized-user purchases count toward the account's rewards, earn to that account and are issued on one certificate per reward year. The gas cap is counted per account across the reward year, never across a cardholder's two accounts. Card rewards are a separate program from the membership's Annual Reward: the two are earned, issued and redeemed independently, and a purchase on the card at a club can earn both.

## Questions answered

**Do an authorized user's purchases build a separate reward balance?**
No. Where the card's authorized-user purchases count toward rewards, they earn to the account itself, alongside the primary cardholder's purchases, within the number of authorized users the card product allows.

**How many card reward certificates does one account receive for a reward year?**
One. Every purchase on the account that earns in that reward year is issued on that single certificate.

**A cardholder has a consumer card and a business card. Is gas and EV charging spend on the two counted toward one cap?**
No. Each account counts its own gas and EV charging spend across its own reward year; the spend on one account never uses up the other account's cap.

**A cardholder pays at a club register with the card. Can the purchase earn card rewards and also the membership's Annual Reward?**
It can earn both. The card reward and the Annual Reward are separate programs: each is earned, issued and redeemed independently of the other.

## Illustration (hypothetical account)

One card account has a primary cardholder and two authorized users whose purchases count toward the account's rewards. In one reward year they spend, on gas and EV charging, $3000.00, $2500.00 and $2000.00. The account counts $7500.00 of gas and EV charging spend for the year against its one cap, and all three cardholders' rewards for that year are issued on the account's one certificate. A second account held by the same primary cardholder counts none of that $7500.00.
